overview_description.description:
Axonius is a cybersecurity asset management platform that provides asset inventory, uncovers security solution coverage gaps, and validates and enforces security policies.

It delivers a unified, extensible, and open system that integrates information from networked devices and existing device-specific standalone management service, creating a single visibility and control environment, enabling Information technology and security operations teams to safely engage device adoption and usage at scale.

about_short_description.short_description: Axonius is an asset inventory management platform that focuses on cybersecurity solutions and policies.

product.name: Axonius Asset Cloud
product.description: A cloud-based asset intelligence platform that aggregates and correlates data from security and IT systems to provide a unified inventory of technology assets, identities, exposures, and controls.

product.name: IT Asset Discovery
product.description: A solution for identifying and classifying hardware, software, cloud resources, identities, and other technology assets across an organization’s environment.

product.name: Exposure Management
product.description: A solution that correlates asset inventory, vulnerabilities, security-control coverage, misconfigurations, ownership, and business context to prioritize and remediate exposures.

product.name: Endpoint Compliance Verification
product.description: A solution for checking whether endpoints meet required security, configuration, and management policies and for identifying gaps that require remediation.

product.name: CMDB Data Quality Improvement
product.description: A solution that reconciles asset data from multiple systems to improve the completeness, accuracy, consistency, and currency of configuration-management databases.

product.name: Cyber Incident Response
product.description: A solution that provides consolidated asset and identity context to help security teams investigate incidents, scope affected systems, and coordinate remediation.
